:.85;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;margin:2px 0;white-space:pre-line}
.wcard small{font-size:11px;opacity:.65}
.ep2{opacity:.45;font-size:13px;padding:4px 2px}
.wdt h3{font-size:26px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:6px}
.wsum{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--sky);margin:16px 0 6px}
.wb{white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.9}
.lb{background:var(--pale);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:0 12px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue)}
.chhead{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin:4px 0 14px}
.chav{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--line);background:var(--pale);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.chav img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.chintro{display:block;margin:4px 0 5px;padding:3px 8px 3px 0;max-width:460px;min-width:130px;min-height:28px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;outline:none;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);cursor:text}
.chintro:empty:before{content:"点击填写角色简介…";color:var(--sky)}
.chintro:focus{border-bottom-color:var(--blue);background:rgba(238,242,252,.55)}
.chn{font-family:"Songti SC",Georgia,serif;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--blue)}.chhead small{opacity:.65}
.chl{display:grid;gap:10px}
.chc{display:flex;gap:12px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.chc:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(45,68,216,.15)}
.chc img{width:70px;height:70px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;flex:none}
.chc b{color:var(--blue);font-weight:500}
.chc p{font-size:13px;margin:3px 0;white-space:pre-line;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}
.chc u{text-decoration:none;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--sky);margin-right:8px}
.fm{columns:2 180px;column-gap:14px}
.fm .fc{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
.item u{text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--sky);margin-right:6px}
.tq{color:#fff;text-align:center;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto 16px;letter-spacing:.1em}
/* doc overlays */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:25;background:#f4f7fe;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:var(--ink)}
.ovb{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;flex-wrap:wrap}
.grow{flex:1}
.dti{flex:1;min-width:140px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:16px;outline:none}
.tb2{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 14px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tb2 button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 11px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue)}
.tb2 button:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.edm{flex:1;display:flex;min-height:0}
.tree{width:200px;overflow:auto;padding:12px;border-right:1.5px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:13px}
.tree a{display:block;cursor:pointer;padding:3px 0;color:var(--ink)}.tree a.l2{padding-left:14px;opacity:.85}.tree a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.eaw,.rdw{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:20px 14px}
.ea,.doc{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:30px 34px;min-height:70%;font-family:"Songti SC","Noto Serif SC",serif;line-height:2;font-size:17px;outline:none;color:#222}
.ea h1,.doc h1{font-size:28px;text-align:center;margin:.8em 0 .5em;color:var(--navy)}
.ea h2,.doc h2{font-size:21px;margin:.8em 0 .3em;color:var(--blue)}
.ea blockquote,.doc blockquote{margin:.8em 1.2em;padding:2px 14px;border-left:4px solid var(--sky);color:#556;background:var(--pale)}
.ea p,.doc p{margin:.35em 0}
.ea ul,.ea ol,.doc ul,.doc ol{margin:.5em 0 .5em 1.6em}
.dm{text-align:center;font-size:12px;opacity:.65;margin-bottom:1em;font-family:sans-serif}
.ovf{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 14px;border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13px}
.ovb .btn,.ovf .btn{padding:3px 14px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tree{display:none}.ea,.doc{padding:20px 18px}}

/* weather */
.wxr{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px}
.wxi{font-size:30px;color:var(--blue);width:40px;text-align:center;line-height:1}
.wxr b{font-size:16px;color:var(--blue);display:block;line-height:1.2;font-weight:500}
.wxr small{font-size:11px;opacity:.65}
.wxb{margin-top:12px;background:var(--pale);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;position:relative;line-height:1.7}
.wxb::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:18px;top:-7px;width:11px;height:11px;background:var(--pale);border-left:1.5px solid var(--line);border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.wxc{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.wxc button{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue)}
.wxc button.on{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue)}

/* music player */
#mp{position:fixed;left:18px;bottom:24px;z-index:16;color:var(--ink);user-select:none;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px)}
#mp .mpb,#mp .mpr,#mp .mpl{display:none}
#mp.ball .mpb{display:flex}#mp.bar .mpr{display:flex}#mp.big .mpl{display:block}
.vk{position:relative;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle,#2a3a9c 0 1.5px,#141f6c 1.5px 3.5px);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(20,33,111,.35);flex:none;overflow:hidden}
.vk::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 20deg,rgba(255,255,255,.24),transparent 18%,transparent 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.24) 68%,transparent 85%)}
.vk::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:33%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fbe98a 0 14%,#fff 16% 52%,var(--blue) 55%);border:1.5px solid #fff}
.spin{animation:vs 5s linear infinite;animation-play-state:paused}
#mp.playing .spin{animation-play-state:running}
@keyframes vs{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.mpb{width:56px;height:56px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border:1.5px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(45,68,216,.28);cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.mpb .vk{width:42px;height:42px}
.mpr{width:320px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);height:56px;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:0 10px 0 7px;border-radius:28px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border:1.5px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(45,68,216,.25);cursor:grab;touch-action:none;position:relative}
.mpr .vk{width:42px;height:42px;margin-right:3px}
.mpt{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ib{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--pale);color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.ib svg{width:16px;height:16px}.ib.pl{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}.ib:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(45,68,216,.3)}
.mpp{position:absolute;left:26px;right:26px;bottom:3px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--pale);overflow:hidden}
.mpp i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--blue)}
.mpl{width:290px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(45,68,216,.3);overflow:hidden}
.mph{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:6px 8px 6px 16px;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.2em;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.mpbd{padding:14px 16px 16px;text-align:center}
.mpl .vk{width:176px;height:176px;margin:4px auto 10px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.mptt{font-size:15px;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:6px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mpl input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--blue)}
.mpd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;opacity:.7}
.mpc2{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin:8px 0}
.mpc2 .ib.pl{width:42px;height:42px}.mpc2 .ib.pl svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.mpmode{font-size:11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue);height:26px}
.mpvr{font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.mpls{max-height:120px;overflow:auto;text-align:left;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:6px}
.mpi{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer}
.mpi:hover{background:var(--pale)}.mpi.on{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.mpi span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.mpi b{opacity:.6;font-weight:400}
.mpa{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}.mpa .btn{padding:2px 12px;font-size:12px}
.mpm{font-size:12px;color:#c0392b;min-height:16px;margin-top:4px}
/* responsive */
@media(max-width:960px){
 .shell{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:10px 10px 90px}
 .side{position:static;padding:0;background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;overflow:visible}
 .prof,.side .foot{display:none}
 #nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;gap:4px;padding:8px 8px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:rgba(246,248,254,.95);border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);z-index:6}
 #nav button{flex:none;padding:5px 12px}
 #nav i{display:none}
 .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;justify-items:center;padding:22px 16px}
 .pol{width:230px}
 .rt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .rt .wg:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}
 .sec{padding:16px 14px}
}

/* V4 atmospheric opening: misty moonlight, floral haze, restrained starfield */
#splash{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 75%,rgba(169,182,212,.34),transparent 65%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 17%,rgba(97,111,151,.27),transparent 48%),linear-gradient(155deg,#101322 0%,#1b2137 46%,#3a435e 100%)}
#splash:before{opacity:.27;z-index:1}
#splash canvas{opacity:.33;z-index:1}
#splash .sc{opacity:.035;z-index:2;filter:blur(3px)}
#splash .mist-layer{position:absolute;inset:-22%;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;opacity:.9;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 24% at 20% 35%,rgba(233,236,247,.17),transparent 85%),radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 22% at 78% 65%,rgba(224,232,247,.21),transparent 88%),radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 28% at 44% 90%,rgba(231,232,243,.24),transparent 85%);filter:blur(28px);animation:mistDrift 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}
#splash .mist-layer.second{opacity:.53;filter:blur(43px);animation-duration:27s;animation-direction:alternate-reverse;transform:scale(1.12)}
#splash>*:not(canvas):not(.mist-layer){z-index:3}
#splash h2{color:#f6f6fa;text-shadow:0 2px 26px rgba(9,12,29,.55);font-weight:400}
#splash p{color:#d9dbe8;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(8,11,26,.65)}
#splash .ld{filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 36px rgba(6,9,26,.48))}
#splash .mn{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(246,247,255,.3),0 0 45px rgba(216,223,244,.13)}
@keyframes mistDrift{0%{translate:-4% 2%;scale:1}50%{translate:3% -2%;scale:1.06}100%{translate:7% 3%;scale:1.02}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#splash .mist-layer{animation:none}}

/* V5: 明亮雾蓝色星空，参考站内浅蓝雾感与四芒星 */
#splash{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 48% at 52% 38%,rgba(204,220,251,.83),transparent 92%),radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 65% at 15% 78%,rgba(153,181,233,.83),transparent 88%),radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 55% at 88% 8%,rgba(102,142,214,.64),transparent 88%),linear-gradient(158deg,#425d9e 0%,#789bd4 36%,#b5c9ed 62%,#8baada 100%);color:#fff}
#splash:before{opacity:.14}
#splash .mist-layer{opacity:1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 25% at 18% 22%,rgba(251,252,255,.81),transparent 84%),radial-gradient(ellipse 88% 27% at 77% 56%,rgba(241,246,255,.77),transparent 84%),radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 33% at 42% 90%,rgba(245,249,255,.7),transparent 85%);filter:blur(39px);animation-duration:22s}
#splash .mist-layer.second{opacity:.83;filter:blur(56px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse 66% 23% at 64% 12%,rgba(245,249,255,.8),transparent 88%),radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 25% at 12% 69%,rgba(224,235,255,.86),transparent 90%),radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 27% at 80% 98%,rgba(238,244,255,.86),transparent 90%)}
#splash canvas{opacity:.98;z-index:2}
#splash h2{text-shadow:0 2px 22px rgba(54,80,145,.52)}
#splash p,#splash .ldt{color:#f8fbff;text-shadow:0 1px 12px rgba(51,79,150,.4)}
#splash .sc{opacity:.065;color:#f4f8ff}
#splash .mn{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ffffff6a,0 0 36px #edf4ff8a}
#splash #enter{box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(58,91,155,.17)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="splash">
  <canvas id="stars"></canvas>
  <div class="mist-layer" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="mist-layer second" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <svg class="cam sc" style="left:-60px;top:-60px" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><use href="#cam"/></svg>
  <svg class="cam sc" style="right:-70px;bottom:-70px;animation-direction:reverse" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><use href="#cam"/></svg>
  <h2>世界缝隙之间</h2>
  <p>我们还有无数时间交汇的未来</p>
  <div class="ld" id="ld">
    <svg class="ring" viewBox="0 0 190 190" width="220" height="220"><circle cx="95" cy="95" r="88" fill="none" stroke="rgba(204,218,246,.18)" stroke-width="5"/><circle id="arc" cx="95" cy="95" r="88" fill="none" stroke="#dce8ff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="553" stroke-dashoffset="553"/></svg>
    <div class="mn"><img src="data:image/png;base64,
